Title:
Editor (Artificial Intelligence)

Company:
Pisco | Pixo

Job category:
Cinema and visual arts field

Location:
Tehran

Employment type:
Full time

Minimum experience:
Three to six years

Salary:
From 40,000,000 Tomans

Required skill tags:
- Video editing and editing
- Editing

Gender:
Not important

Military service:
Not important

Education:
Not important

Date posted:
2026-07-05

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
- Professional creation of Instagram, Reels, YouTube, and advertising videos - Design of various posts, stories, banners, covers, slides, and promotional content - Creation of simple and semi-professional motion graphics - Production of visual content with the help of artificial intelligence tools - Collaboration with marketing, content, and SEO teams - Simultaneous management of multiple projects and adherence to deadlines - Providing creative ideas for advertising campaigns Essential skills: - Photoshop (Professional) - Illustrator (Professional) - Premiere Pro (Professional) - CapCut (Professional) - Canva (Professional) - After Effects - Mastery of design for social networks - Mastery of editing for Reels and short videos - Complete understanding of branding and visual identity principles - Good understanding of digital marketing and advertising AI skills: - ChatGPT - Midjourney - Adobe Firefly - Runway - Kling - Veo - Leonardo AI - Canva AI The ability to generate images, videos, ideas, scenarios, and optimize design processes with the help of AI is required. Personal characteristics: - Responsible - Organized - Teamwork ability - Appropriate accountability - Creative and idea generator - Time management ability - Quick learning of new technologies Working conditions: - Presence required every day for the first 2 months and then hybrid - Online presence during working hours - Submission of daily or weekly reports - Having a suitable system for editing and design - This position does not include social security insurance. Interview conditions: - Submission of a portfolio is mandatory. - Submission of at least 3 design samples and 3 video samples is mandatory. - Individuals with experience in the medical field, clinics, and digital marketing are prioritized. - Mastery in content production with an AI approach is considered a very important advantage.

Company description:
Since 1394, Almanat, Almaطب, Pixo started its activities in the field of medicine with a young, creative, and committed team, bringing a new revolution in digital marketing in this industry. By analyzing the market, understanding consumer behavior, and utilizing the latest digital marketing techniques and artificial intelligence, we have gone beyond being an advertising agency and have become a strategic partner for doctors and medical centers. Throughout its years of activity, we have executed more than 1000 successful projects for doctors and have collaborated with dozens of medical associations in Iran. Using modern marketing solutions, designing modern and user-friendly websites, and developing powerful content strategies, we help doctors improve their brands, have more effective interactions with patients, and be seen professionally online.
